name: Tie decided by fair play
source: FIFA World Cup 2018, Group H, official final table. Team names replaced: Colombia=Condors, Japan=Kites, Senegal=Lions, Poland=Pines. Yellow-card totals match the official fair-play record (Kites -4, Lions -6); how those cards were spread over the matches is not reproduced, which does not affect the table.
why: Kites and Lions finished level on points (4), goal difference (0), goals scored (4) and their 2-2 meeting. Fair play decides: Kites 4 points against, Lions 6.
